2607.12640.title: A Learning-Rate-Gated Failure of GRPO in a Small Language and Vision-Language Model Web Agent: A Controlled Null and Its Mechanism
2607.12640.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) in particular, is now run routinely on a supervised checkpoint in the hope of producing a stronger agent. We ask whether it adds skill to a small language and vision-language model web agent at the 4B to 8B scale, or whether it mostly reshapes behavior the supervised model already has. Across a control grid of 18 runs that varies learning rate, KL weight, seed, initialization, and clipping, no configuration credibly improves the success rate of a strong supervised baseline on tasks the agent has largely mastered. On the text track, moderate to high learning rates make it credibly worse. The null holds under paired testing, 25 evaluation seeds, 6 training seeds, changes to the recipe, both text and Set-of-Marks screenshot observations, and scaling the backbone to 8B; the credible harm is a text-track finding and is only nominal under Set-of-Marks. To show that the null reflects the setting and not a broken pipeline, we run the identical harness, reward, and recipe on tasks whose reward is reachable by sampling, and there the success rate rises by 22 points with a paired interval that excludes zero. GRPO therefore helps only when there is headroom to climb, meaning the sampled policy already succeeds more often than the greedy one. We then explain the failure. A middle learning rate degrades the agent and a high one collapses it, and the two regimes form a double dissociation: grafting localizes the degrade regime to the attention and MLP blocks, while the collapse regime cannot be traced to any single group, and the embedding change that dominates the weight movement is causally inert. At 4B, effective rank in the late layers tracks capability in both directions; at 8B the two come apart. This coupling is specific to the smaller model, so we report it as scale-dependent.
2607.12640.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵，特別是群體相對策略優化（GRPO），現在在監督檢查點上常規運行，希望能產生更強的代理。我們詢問它是否為一個小型語言和視覺-語言模型的網絡代理在4B到8B的規模上增加了技能，或者它是否主要重塑了監督模型已經具備的行為。在一個控制網格中進行的18次運行中，變化了學習率、KL權重、隨機種子、初始化和裁剪，沒有任何配置可信地改善強監督基線在代理已經基本掌握的任務上的成功率。在文本軌道上，中等到高的學習率使其可信地變得更糟。在配對測試、25個評估種子、6個訓練種子、食譜變更、文本和標記集截圖觀察以及將骨幹擴展到8B的情況下，零假設成立；可信的損害是一個文本軌道的發現，在標記集下僅是名義上的。為了顯示零假設反映了設置而不是破損的管道，我們在獎勵可通過抽樣獲得的任務上運行相同的裝置、獎勵和食譜，並且那裡的成功率上升了22個點，配對區間排除了零。因此，GRPO僅在有上升空間的情況下才有幫助，這意味著抽樣策略的成功率已經高於貪婪策略。我們接著解釋失敗的原因。中等學習率使代理退化，而高學習率使其崩潰，這兩種狀態形成了雙重解離：接枝將退化狀態局限於注意力和MLP區塊，而崩潰狀態無法追溯到任何單一組，主導權重變動的嵌入變化在因果上是無效的。在4B時，後期層的有效秩在兩個方向上跟踪能力；在8B時，兩者分開。這種耦合特定於較小的模型，因此我們將其報告為規模依賴性。
